279	
280	The Picard scheme `Pic_{C/k}` of a smooth proper geometrically integral curve
281	`C/k` **with a `k`-rational point** is the `k`-scheme representing the
282	relative Picard functor `picSharp C` (which, under the rational point, agrees
283	with the étale-sheafified functor of Kleiman §4 Thm `th:main` by Kleiman §2
284	Thm 2.5). The scheme is separated, locally of finite type over `k`, and a
285	disjoint union of open quasi-projective `k`-subschemes; the
286	abelian-group-scheme structure is `groupSchemeStructure` below.
287	
288	Blueprint reference: `def:pic_scheme` (Kleiman §4 Def. `df:Psch`). -/
289

292	locally of finite type over `k`.
293	
294	**This is the legacy, conditional interface, not the headline target.** Its only
295	producer is `picSchemeOfHasRationalPoint`, which needs `[HasRationalPoint C]`
296	(from which it derives the comparison via

303	kernel-clean and valid; what they prove are conditional statements until
304	restated against `picEt`.

307	existential because Kleiman §4 Thm `th:main`(1) delivers them as one package:

317	    Nonempty ((PicScheme.picSharp C).RepresentableBy X) ∧
